prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Review a medical appointment capacity chart using the supplied specification. Read interface.md. Audit the supplied interface; rank verified findings and show corrected behavior. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Use a framework-agnostic specification or pseudocode; do not assume an Apple SDK is available.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: macOS. A bar chart starts at 48 and exaggerates 50 versus 54 appointments, has unlabeled axes, red/green series without another distinction and no textual values or accessibility description. Counts are daily nonnegative totals; no screenshot is supplied.

criteria.task_completion: Correct baseline, labels, distinguishable encoding and accessible value access, while separating verified specification defects from unmeasured rendering concerns.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the charts guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Correct baseline, labels, distinguishable encoding and accessible value access, while separating verified specification defects from unmeasured rendering concerns.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Correct baseline, labels, distinguishable encoding and accessible value access, while separating verified specification defects from unmeasured rendering concerns.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.

required_findings.description: Bar lengths use a truncated 48 baseline, exaggerating count differences.
Axes lack meaningful labels and units.
Series rely solely on red/green color.
Exact numerical values are not available textually.
No accessible chart purpose/summary or description is supplied.

rubric.review_threshold: Find at least four of five seeded defects, including every critical defect; no invented high-severity finding.
